product.title: Capabilities
product.lead: Organized by deliverable outcomes—not a tech-stack laundry list.
product.linesLead: Foundation governance, OA workflow, and engineering codegen form the delivery surface.

c1.title: Multi-tenant & org permissions
c1.body: One account per tenant with clear platform vs tenant boundaries; orgs, roles, and data scope.

c2.title: Menus, RBAC & security
c2.body: Navigation separated from permission codes; login hardening, IP rules, and log redaction.

c3.title: Workflow & OA
c3.body: Process design, approvals, and tenant office configuration for real approval workloads.

c4.title: Codegen & engineering norms
c4.body: CRUD generation and consistent project structure to accelerate standard admin modules.

c5.title: Async jobs & Excel import
c5.body: Keep sync import for simple cases; large files go async—API returns a task id, work runs in the background, UI polls for results. User async jobs stay separate from platform cron; transport is environment config, with tenant isolation on every task.

c6.title: Configurable & extensible
c6.body: Config, dictionaries, i18n, and clean extension seams—grow business on the foundation.

c7.title: Deployable & maintainable
c7.body: Initialization baselines and ops-minded features for production—not demos only.

c8.title: Domestic stack readiness
c8.body: Abstractions for DB, cache, and files to ease migration in regulated environments.
